# govulncheck OSV IDs accepted as known, reviewed exceptions.
# The CI govulncheck job fails on any AFFECTING vuln NOT listed here, so a
# new finding breaks the build while these documented ones don't.
#
# GO-2026-5932 — golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained (no fix version
#   exists). Pulled in transitively by the Helm SDK (action package) for
#   chart provenance/signature verification. Ergoz never verifies chart
#   signatures, so the vulnerable code is init-only reachable and never
#   exercised at runtime. Remove this line if ergoz ever calls Helm's
#   provenance verification, or if x/crypto ships a fixed openpgp.
GO-2026-5932
